blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Twenty senators filed a resolution on Monday urging President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to declare a state of calamity over areas affected by the El Niño. Senate Resolution No. 765 was introduced by Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian, Senate President Pro Tempore Vicente Sotto III, Majority Leader Juan Miguel Zubiri, Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano and Sens. Francis Pangilinan, JV Ejercito, Francis Escudero, Risa Hontiveros, Bam Aquino, Joel Villanueva, Panfilo Lacson, Raffy Tulfo, Erwin Tulfo, Lito Lapid, Pia Cayetano, Christopher Go, Imee Marcos, Robin Padilla, Mark Villar and Camille Villar.
